title: Pan-Seared Xiaolongbao with Smoky Dipping Sauce
description: A classic Chinese Xiaolongbao recipe with a smoky twist. The smoky dipping sauce adds a rich and savory flavor to the delicate pork dumplings.

ingredients.name: Ground pork
ingredients.notes: Make sure to handle the pork safely and cook it to an internal temperature of 160°F (71°C)

ingredients.name: Shallots
ingredients.notes: Finely chop the shallots before adding them to the pork mixture

ingredients.name: Ginger
ingredients.notes: Grate the ginger and add it to the pork mixture

ingredients.name: Soy sauce
ingredients.notes: Use a gluten-free soy sauce if necessary

ingredients.name: Smoky dipping sauce (see below for recipe)

instructions: Combine ground pork, shallots, ginger, and soy sauce in a bowl. Mix well until just combined.
Place a Xiaolongbao wrapper on a flat surface. Place a tablespoon of the pork mixture in the center of the wrapper.
Dip your finger in a small amount of water and run it along the edges of the wrapper.
Fold the wrapper into a triangle by bringing the two opposite corners together to form a point. Press the edges together to seal the dumpling.
Repeat with the remaining wrappers and pork mixture.
Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the Xiaolongbao to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until the bottoms are golden brown.
Add 1/2 cup of water to the skillet and cover with a lid.
Steam the Xiaolongbao for 5-7 minutes, or until they are cooked through.
Serve the Xiaolongbao with the smoky dipping sauce.
